verdict.rationale: Productboard claims AI-driven analysis of feedback trends with citations for every finding and a built-in synthesis agent. Its official MCP server also lets assistants like Claude and ChatGPT read workspace data, including feedback, and feedback can be linked to companies and features. Nothing in the evidence shows the assistant answering questions about revenue impact, such as ARR or deal value tied to themes. Missing for 10: revenue-impact analysis of feedback themes, a documented natural-language Q&A flow over feedback themes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
